service_name: Water Supply Complaint Channel (Smart City Indore)
sub_service: Water supply complaints via Smart City Indore's grievance registration system
problem_type: No/low water supply, water quality issues
municipality: Indore Municipal Corporation (IMC) / Smart City Indore
description: Smart City Indore's own grievance-registration page (a genuinely different, working page from the previously-checked ABD Water Supply RFP document and IMC's own site, both confirmed empty/exhausted in earlier rounds) lists 'Water Supply' as one of its named complaint categories, with a real phone/email contact. A separate Smart City Indore Citizen Charter page publishes only generic project-complaint-category SLAs (Site/Design/Execution/Permission/Fraud/Other issues, T+3 to T+15 working days) that are not explicitly mapped to routine civic services like water supply -- so no category-specific SLA is claimed here.
procedure: Register a complaint under the 'Water Supply' category via Smart City Indore's grievance portal, Indore 311 app, phone, or email.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for water-supply complaints specifically. Smart City Indore's Citizen Charter separately publishes generic project-grievance timelines (T+3 to T+15 working days across Site/Design/Execution/Permission/Fraud/Other categories) but these are not stated to apply to routine civic service complaints like water supply.

escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE for this category specifically -- the Citizen Charter mentions a Level-3 escalation via CRM to an Executive Director for unresolved cases generally (response within 10 working days), not confirmed as applicable to water-supply complaints specifically.
